trend: Melatonin under review in the EU; AASM advises against it for chronic insomnia in adults
why: A clear 'why we left it out' answers a question every sleep-product buyer has.
text:
Why there's no melatonin in SILT Nights.

US sleep doctors (AASM) advise against it for chronic insomnia in adults, and the EU is still reviewing it. We wanted something you can take every night, so we built around 3 g glycine, magnesium bisglycinate, ashwagandha and L-theanine.
